04 / Reading the record

How these figures are counted

Recorded spend adds published payments and subtracts published refunds. A quotation or bill alone does not change the total.

A workday is a date with a confirmed work attendance entry. Worker-days add the people recorded on those dates. A date with no entry is unknown, not a day off.

Material quantities retain their item, specification, unit and event type. Buying steel does not prove it was delivered or installed.

Historical notes reconstructed later will be labelled. Private receipts, worker identities, detailed plans and exact location are not published here.
